name: Lobachevsky’s hyperbolic geometry
description: Lobachevsky developed a geometry in which Euclid’s parallel postulate does not hold.

impact.note: Provisional consequence judgement; actual reach and later attribution require independent study.

events.statement: Lobachevsky presented imaginary geometry at Kazan University.

evidence.supports: Dates the Kazan presentation of imaginary geometry to 1826.
Contrasts alternatives to the Euclidean parallel postulate and discusses Lobachevsky and Bolyai.

contributions.resource: Developed and presented an alternative geometry.
